g.text: Precondition: active configuration valid and every asset preloaded
(VIS01 sequence_diagram_open_viewer, step 5). Origin = centre of the floor.
defaultSceneModules = [layout, lighting, camera]: the camera module runs LAST.
camera.aspect already matches the canvas (VIS01 resize).
horizontal and vertical FOV, x FIT_MARGIN
mouseButtons = { LEFT: PAN, MIDDLE: DOLLY, RIGHT: ROTATE }
